method: git patch-id --stable, equality of stable patch-ids
note: A fork commit absent from this file was measured at upstream_tip and has no equivalent patch-id there. That is a measurement, not an assumption - provided the commit is within the population, which check-upstream-retirement.py verifies.
population: every non-merge commit reachable from population_commit; batch 1 emitted a stable patch-id for each and intersected the set with the upstream tip's
